note: Renders: scratchpad/w16 (m01-m19) and w16q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 2e3ebfa. git diff 3368ba0..2e3ebfa shows no change to 10_mono.js. The changes that reach monument views are in other areas: the galley and door vinyl (07_shell MAT.vinyl #6e6b6e -> #6f6a69, imperceptible), a new light grey-cream door-window rim (WMAT.doorSeal, visible in m17 and m18 and consistent with lalf_133), the shade buttons, the grille and the econ fabric. The w15 renders are no longer in the scratchpad, so I re-sampled every w15 evidence box instead of diffing images. All of them return the w15 values exactly: m03 pane #2b2a2b / #3e3c3d, m03 latch #54575c (std 3.4), m07 curtain #393c47, m04 frame #bab3a7 (std 13.6), m04 red tab #d72a2c, m04 ash std 10.4, m09 frame p10 #757470, m17 lav door std 3.5, q01 wood #3f3737 (std 13.1), q11 counter edge p10 #030305, q11 bar doors std 9.6. The monuments are therefore unchanged, and I keep the w15 scores. Lighting is noted but not scored: q19 still whites out the rear galley ceiling, and the m01/m09/m12 upper compartments are still fogged. Scripts: scratchpad/raterB16/s.py (mean / p10 / p90 by luminance, std) and sheet.py. Contact sheets: raterB16/sh0-sh3.png. Close-ups: raterB16/m17win.png and m04corner.png.

issues.problem: The silver latch is a tall rounded rectangle with brushed horizontal stripes, so it reads as a vent grille. In the photo the latch is a horizontal oval with a vertical thumb-turn, set in a D-shaped boss.
issues.evidence: m03 (470,295,482,320) is #54575c with std 3.4 and is taller than wide. omaat_room_32 (718,435,770,455) is #665d48 and shows a wide oval.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley in 10_mono.js, make the latch wider than tall (about 0.075 x 0.045 m) as a fully rounded plate in a plain bright metal ({c:'#c9c6bf', r:0.3, m:0.6}, no brushed layer). Add a dark 0.012 x 0.035 m thumb-turn at its centre and a round D-shaped boss behind it. Note that gRBox clamps the radius to d/2, so a true oval needs an extruded rounded-rect outline.

issues.problem: The pane has no glass cue. The contents read crisp, with no reflection, so in m16 the cabinet reads as open shelving.
issues.evidence: The m16 pane interior shows crisp boxes and shelves. omaat_room_32 shows a diagonal light reflection band and a dimmer, softer interior (#22201f upper).
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley, add a quad just in front of the pane opening with a faint glass material ({c:'#8a8886', r:0.08, m:0.6, a:0.15}), or a single diagonal pale strip about 0.08 m wide (e 0.02) as the reflection band.

issues.detail: Door-2 ash-wall flap frames and latch (m04)
issues.problem: The frames are flat strokes in the plane of the wall, with no lit top edge, and at 930 px the corners read square. The red tabs are a pure, saturated red and sit inside the frame instead of straddling its top rail.
issues.evidence: m04 frame (125,250,140,450) is #bab3a7 with std 13.6, and the red tab (237,194,247,203) is #d72a2c. In lalf_133 the frame is rounded with a highlight, and the clips are #66201a.
issues.fix: In the door-2 ash-wall builder in 10_mono.js, raise the flapFrame radius from 0.05 to 0.08 m with a real rounded outline (gRBox clamps r to d/2) and its depth from 0.016 to 0.025 m. Add a 6 mm lighter strip on the top inner edge. Change the tabs to {c:'#8e2a1c', r:0.25} and raise them so they overlap the frame top.

issues.problem: A dark overhanging slab sits over a separate grey rail, whereas samchui_render_11 has a bright band wrapping the top edge.
issues.evidence: q11 (100,358,580,372) is #48494c with p10 #030305. samchui_render_11 shows a bright edge band at about y 380.
issues.fix: In buildBar, move the steelBright nosing up so it is flush with the top edge of the deck and make it 0.03 m tall. Drop the separate lower rail or darken it.

issues.detail: Carry-overs: jump-seat straps, bassinet bar, opaque tumbler bodies
issues.problem: The straps read as 6 px rods (m13, m17, m18), the bassinet bar remains on the J/PY bulkhead (m08), and the tumbler bodies are opaque near-black (m05).
issues.evidence: These pixels are unchanged from w15.
issues.fix: Draw the straps as flat 0.04 x 0.003 m webbing boxes. Drop the bassinet bar or reduce it to two small sockets. Give the tumblers c '#5a5e64', r 0.05, m 0.3.

gapWorth03: Taken together, the ash-wall frame and latch rework, the welcome-cabinet oval latch and glass reflection, the flush bar nosing, and the fine ashDoor grain on the bar and ash wall would lift the door-2 ash wall, welcome galley and bar details by about 0.3 each. That would bring the area to about 8.6. The w17 candidate (3ea3f24) appears to target exactly these items.
